objects.description: The [QakBot](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0650) payload has been disguised as a PNG file and hidden within LNK files using a Microsoft File Explorer icon.(Citation: Group IB Ransomware September 2020)(Citation: Trend Micro Black Basta October 2022)
